SkillError.doc: A skill-level failure. `hint`: what to change; `diagnosis`: the library's, for the log; `details`: every

ObjectNotFound.hint: check the object's display name or id in the active world

AmbiguousObject.hint: several objects carry that display name: pass the world id instead

AnchorNotFound.hint: use one of the object's anchors (list_anchors), or teach the anchor in its project object copy

GripperMismatch.hint: use the arm whose gripper the anchor was taught for, or teach the anchor for this gripper

AlreadyHolding.hint: release what the arm holds first

NotHolding.hint: close the gripper on it and attach it first

HeldByOtherArm.hint: release it from the other arm first (or hand it over)

SeatOccupied.hint: the seat is taken: clear it or choose another anchor

SeatMismatch.hint: the holder does not declare this object type for that seat (live_state seats)

HolderHasOccupants.hint: move what sits on it first

MotionFailed.doc: A motion request that did not end at its goal.

Unreachable.hint: move the object, loosen the tolerance, or approach from elsewhere

WouldCollide.hint: if the contact is intended, declare it: a `with contact(arm, *targets, parts=...)` scope, or allow=contact(...) on the move

JointLimit.hint: approach from another direction, or wind the wrist the other way first (a joint pose)

StraightLineImpossible.hint: start the straight move from elsewhere, or drop straight_line

NoRoute.hint: add a via pose (via=[...]) or a taught joint pose on the way

ConstraintViolated.hint: the constraint does not hold at the start or cannot be kept: loosen it or start elsewhere

MotionStalled.hint: the arm was held where it stopped: something is in the way or the goal moved

MotionAborted.hint: stopped by a stop, a world change or a fault; the arm was brought to rest

ArmNotInSetup.hint: use one of the setup's arms

ArmNotInLeg.hint: inside run_parallel each leg moves its own arm only

DualArmRequired.hint: this setup has one arm: run the legs one after the other

TcpSpeedOnFreeMove.hint: a free move takes speed= (a fraction of the joint-speed limit); tcp_speed (m/s) needs straight_line=True

StaleArmState.hint: the arm's joint stream stopped or never reported: check the arm and its connection

NotAvailableInSim.hint: branch on is_sim_mode() for this step

MotionUnavailable.hint: the active set has no motion controller (the real set needs ZEON_MOTION_ALLOW_REAL=1)

record_transfer.doc: Mark a completed transfer in the resume ledger and persist it.

is_transfer_done.doc: Return True if a planned op already completed for this execution.

clear_skill_variable.doc: Remove a variable from skill storage.

pause_for_user.doc: Slack-ping the user, pause the workflow, run a resolve callback on resume.

register_custom_resume.doc: Register a skill-wide custom resume action.

unregister_custom_resume.doc: Drop a previously-registered custom resume action. Safe if unknown.

pause_checkpoint.doc: Explicit pause yield-point for gaps between motion commands.

ask_user_slack.doc: Pause the workflow, ask the operator with buttons, return the choice.

get_world_state.doc: Return the per-world *live state* for one object, keyed by its world id.

set_world_state.doc: Merge `updates` into an object's live-state entry and persist it.

SkillObject.doc: A world object passed directly into a skill function.

ExecutionInfoContext.doc: Thread-local holder for the current execution/node identifiers.

set.doc: Install execution info for the current thread.

clear.doc: Remove execution info after skill execution completes.

get.doc: Return the current execution info, or empty info if none installed.

require_epipette.doc: Raise unless `name` is an enabled pipette on this rig.
